decision: Blocking first step: convex/lib/transcripts.ts (constants + listProjectTranscripts + metadata + pure helpers); schema widen is independent of it
why: foundational thinking: the data shape and the one definition of "a project's transcripts" gate every other edit

decision: Independent workstreams: (a) convex/schema.ts additive widen, (b) convex/lib/transcripts.ts + convex/transcripts.ts, (c) docs/product-domain.md amendment
why: sequence work into verifiable units: each ends in its own check (tsc, vitest, rg)

decision: Shared mutable state touched: convex/schema.ts only (additive fields + new transcriptDigests table); generations.transcriptId stays required
why: migrate callers then delete legacy APIs: the relaxation lands in transcripts-2 with the two readers at generations.ts:544/:580, so tsc stays green here

decision: Smallest safe decomposition: 4 commits — schema widen, lib helper, query surface, domain amendment + evidence
why: laziness protocol: no writer, generation, UI or ingestion change in this ticket

decision: Schema widened additively in one commit; transcriptDigests keyed by (transcriptId, sourceContentHash, condenseVersion)
why: foundational thinking: the digest key is laid down by the ticket that creates the table, so a prompt or size change can never reuse a stale digest

decision: Put ordering, the empty-row drop and the 20-row cap in listProjectTranscripts instead of at each call site
why: model the domain: one definition of "a project's transcripts"; the only direct table queries left are deleteProject cascade and the admin orphan scan, which are deliberately not that definition

decision: Split the client read: listTranscripts returns metadata only, getTranscriptContent returns one body
why: experience first: 20 rows x 400k chars would push ~8MB through one reactive subscription that panels only preview on click

decision: Added a returns validator to the pre-existing getTranscript query while touching it
why: boundary discipline: the repo lint hook flags a query without one, and getTranscript now returns a helper result rather than a raw first()

decision: Kept wordCount computed in transcriptMetadata rather than stored on the row
why: laziness protocol: storing charCount/wordCount is a writer change, and transcripts-3 owns insertTranscriptRow; validation-2 records it as low

decision: Installed dependencies with npm ci after bun install rejected the frozen lockfile
why: prove it works: the worktree shipped without node_modules, so no gate could run; npm ci leaves bun.lock and package-lock.json untouched

decision: Gate bash scripts/loop-verify.sh exit 0 (tsc, svelte-check 0 errors, 116 files / 1132 tests)
why: prove it works: ladder 4, the suite fails loud if the widen broke an existing writer

decision: All 9 done_when predicates run by hand, all exit 0
why: state the exit condition as a checkable predicate
